title: Add RecipeRowView
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeRowView.swift rendering a single recipe row: leading RecipeThumbnailView(thumbnailURL: recipe.thumbnailURL) at 56×56 pt, center recipe.displayName text, trailing chevron.right SF Symbol. Accepts a RecipeFile value. Row will be embedded in a List and tapped via the parent's .sheet(item:) binding — no NavigationLink.
acceptance_criteria: Leading slot renders RecipeThumbnailView with recipe.thumbnailURL
Trailing slot renders chevron.right SF Symbol
Does not use NavigationLink — tapping is handled by .sheet(item:) in the parent list
